# graphql-orm-client

A GraphQL client for graphql-orm APIs: fragments colocated with components, compiled route
queries, a normalised store and live updates from generated Changed subscriptions. Status:
early alpha; APIs may still change. Read the installed docs, which match the installed version.

Start here, in order:

1. skills/graphql-orm-client-adopt: install it and wire it up.
2. skills/graphql-orm-client-data: write components, roots and mutations. Mark fragments `@live` if the record can change on screen.
3. skills/graphql-orm-client-live: keep data current, draw its status, and diagnose stale data.

Also skills/graphql-orm-client-streams for data that isn't an entity, and skills/graphql-orm-client-server for backend changes.
